# `/entitlement-recommendations` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /entitlement-recommendations/v1/pending-approvals

`listPendingEntitlementRecommendationApprovalsV1` — List pending entitlement recommendation approvals — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Returns a list of entitlement recommendations (SED and/or privilege) that are currently awaiting review or approval. Each record includes the recommendation type, entitlement details, and any AI-generated suggestions.

- Scopes: idn:sed:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
- Returns 200: array of entitlementrecommendationrecord

### POST /entitlement-recommendations/v1/bulk-approve

`approveBulkEntitlementRecommendationsV1` — Bulk approve entitlement recommendations — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Approve multiple entitlement recommendations in a single request. Each item in the request must include the recommendation ID and, depending on the record type, either an approved description (SED items) or an approved privilege level (privilege items). Returns a per-item result indicating success or failure.

- Scopes: idn:sed:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Body (application/json): bulkapproveentitlementrecommendationrequest
- Returns 200: array of bulkapproveentitlementrecommendationresult

### POST /entitlement-recommendations/v1/assign

`submitEntitlementRecommendationsAssignmentV1` — Assign entitlement recommendations for review — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Assign a set of entitlement recommendation records to a reviewer. The assignee can be a specific identity, a governance group, or a role-based assignee such as source owner or entitlement owner. Returns a batch ID that can be used to track the assignment.

- Scopes: idn:sed:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Body (application/json): entitlementrecommendationassignrequest
- Returns 202: entitlementrecommendationassignresult

### PATCH /entitlement-recommendations/v1/{id}

`patchEntitlementRecommendationV1` — Update an entitlement recommendation — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Partially update a single entitlement recommendation record by its ID. Use this endpoint to update the status, description, or privilege level of a specific SED or privilege recommendation.

- Scopes: idn:sed:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The unique identifier of the entitlement recommendation to update.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: entitlementrecommendationrecord
